Translation: In the Name of Allah, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: اَللّٰهُمَّ مَا عَمِلْتُ فِيْ هٰذِهِ السَّنَةِ
Translation: O Allah, whatever deeds I have done in this year

Arabic text: مِنْ عَمَلٍ نَهَيْتَنِيْ عَنْهُ وَلَمْ تَرْضَهُ
Translation: from actions which You forbade me from and were not pleased with
and I forgot them but You did not forget

Arabic text: وَدَعَوْتَنِيْ إِلَى التَّوْبَةِ بَعْدَ اجْتِرَائِي عَلَيْكَ
Translation: and You called me to repentance after my boldness against You

Arabic text: اَللّٰهُمَّ فَإِنِّي أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ مِنْهُ فَاغْفِرْ لِيْ
Translation: O Allah, I seek Your forgiveness for it, so forgive me

Arabic text: وَمَا عَمِلْتُ مِنْ عَمَلٍ يُقَرِّبُنِيْ إِلَيْكَ
Translation: And whatever deeds I have done that bring me closer to You

Arabic text: فَاقْبَلْهُ مِنِّي وَلَا تَقْطَعْ رَجَائِي مِنْكَ يَا كَرِيمُ
Translation: accept them from me and do not cut off my hope from You, O Generous One
